subtopic: TVM / Relax VM runtime — dynamic execution model
learningObjective: Understand the role of the Relax VM in executing compiled TVM programs and its position relative to static compilation.
stem: Which statement about the Relax VM in TVM is correct?

options.text: The Relax VM is a bytecode-based runtime that executes a compiled Relax program: it dispatches PrimFunc calls, external-library calls, and control flow, and it handles dynamic-shape allocation and object lifetime — enabling static compilation of graph structure with runtime resolution of dynamic dimensions.

The Relax VM is a Python interpreter that parses and executes Relax IR line-by-line at runtime; it does not require any AOT compilation of PrimFuncs, and switching to a different target only requires changing an environment variable.
The Relax VM eliminates the need for a compiler: it JIT-compiles TensorIR at every function call, so the entire tuning + scheduling pipeline runs at inference time.
The Relax VM only supports CPU targets; GPU execution in TVM is handled by a separate compile-time-only pipeline that emits standalone `.so` files without any VM involvement.

explanation: The Relax VM is a lightweight bytecode-based runtime for TVM Unity that dispatches operator calls (both PrimFunc and external-lib), handles dynamic-shape memory allocation, supports control flow, and manages object lifetime. Static compilation happens ahead of time for PrimFunc; the VM ties it all together at runtime. This separation is what allows compile-time optimization while preserving dynamic-shape flexibility.

optionExplanations.A: Correct: bytecode VM dispatching precompiled PrimFunc + externals + control flow + dynamic allocation.
optionExplanations.B: Wrong: Relax VM is not a Python interpreter of IR.
optionExplanations.C: Wrong: it does not JIT the tuning pipeline; PrimFuncs are precompiled.
optionExplanations.D: Wrong: the VM works for GPU targets as well.

assumptions: Relax VM design as documented in TVM Unity.
nonImplications: Does not imply the VM has zero overhead; bytecode dispatch has a cost that AOTInductor-style packaging can avoid.
Does not imply the VM is required for every deployment; some flows bake to a lower-level runtime.

distractorRationales.B: Confuses Relax VM with a Python interpreter of IR.
